brief: Rename the exported function calcTotal to sumPrices in math.mjs and its consumer invoice.mjs. Remove the old export; preserve behavior.

files.math.mjs: export function calcTotal(prices) { return prices.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); }
files.invoice.mjs:
import { calcTotal } from './math.mjs';
export const invoice = prices => calcTotal(prices);

brief: Fix average([]) to return null, preserving arithmetic means for nonempty numeric arrays. Add a node:test regression test in average.test.mjs.

files.average.mjs: export const average = xs => xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / xs.length;

brief: Implement unique(xs) in unique.mjs: keep the first occurrence of each string, preserving order and case. Do not mutate input. Add node:test coverage in unique.test.mjs.

files.unique.mjs: export function unique(xs) { throw new Error('not implemented'); }

brief: Inspect the routes and write findings.json containing exactly the alphabetically sorted route names whose handlers call audit (direct calls only), under key audited. Do not change source files.
Create usage.md documenting actual parsePort behavior, including default 8080, valid range 1-65535, invalid values throwing RangeError, and a working ESM import example. Do not change port.mjs.

files.port.mjs: export function parsePort(value = '8080') { if (!/^\d+$/.test(value) || +value < 1 || +value > 65535) throw new RangeError('port'); return +value; }

brief: Fix the flaky expiry boundary: expired(expiry, now) should return true exactly when now >= expiry. Make the current time injectable, defaulting to Date.now(). Add deterministic node:test cases in expiry.test.mjs; do not use sleeps.

files.expiry.mjs: export function expired(expiry) { return Date.now() > expiry; }

brief: Implement csvCell(value) for string input: quote cells containing comma, double quote, CR or LF, doubling embedded double quotes; otherwise return unchanged. Add node:test coverage in csv.test.mjs.

Fix isChild(root, candidate) in child.mjs for normalized POSIX absolute paths: root itself is not a child, descendants are, sibling prefixes are not. Root '/' contains every other absolute path. Do not import platform-dependent path helpers. Add node:test cases in child.test.mjs.
Implement page(items, offset, limit): return a slice, without mutating input. Offset and limit must be nonnegative integers; otherwise throw RangeError. Add node:test cases in page.test.mjs.

files.page.mjs: export function page(items, offset, limit) { return items; }

brief: Implement mergeConfig(defaults, overrides): shallow merge using only override values that are not undefined; preserve null/false/0/empty string, do not mutate inputs. Add node:test coverage in config.test.mjs.
